--

Bean dip. 3 cans refried beans, 3 cans beef, 3 8oz cans chopped jalapeños. Put into crock pot on high for 3-4 hours. Add shredded cheese, sour cream, whatever when it's done.

--

Burgers. Two pounds ground beef, one beef liver, ground (for nutrition and extra meaty flavor). Add an egg. Add salt, pepper, paprika, Worcester sauce to taste. Toast one slice of bread to dark in toaster oven. Crumble into beef mixture for instant bread crumbs. Mix everything together.

Cook on cast iron skillet. In another skillet cook bacon and onions (at same time). Place pairs of bread into toaster oven, one on another (toasty outside but soft inside). I just use mustard for condiments.

--

Fried rice. Cook three cups rice. Start cooking a pound of bacon split between two cast iron skillets. Chop them into little bits with spatula. Get it nice and crispy. Add rice and mix well. Add green onions and mix well. Scramble six eggs, add salt and pepper, then split between pans and mix well. Add soy sauce til is brown. Add green onions at end. When you smell the onions, it's done.

--

Bacon wrapped hot dogs. Use a long strip of bacon, start at a 45° angle and twist bacon around hot dog, overlapping bacon with previous wrap. Put loose end onto bottom of skillet and DON'T TOUCH for like five minutes. Let the bacon contract, get tight, get crispy on hot dog and it'll hold itself on. You don't need toothpicks if you do it this way.
